001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.CurrentBatteryV2Response;
007
008/**
009 * Battery snapshot written when charging stops, on both the Mobi and the t:slim X2, whether the
010 * pump was taken off the charger or charging finished at 100%. Every
011 * {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response} chargingStatus 1 to 0 transition seen in the maintainer's and a
012 * tester's Mobi captures (9 of 9) has one within seconds, and every record matches such a
013 * transition. On the t:slim X2 it usually follows a {@link UsbDisconnectedHistoryLog}.
014 *
015 * The class name is provisional: opcode 35 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
016 * app's history log list. {@link ChargingStartedHistoryLog} has the same layout. Fields not named
017 * here have not been identified and are exposed raw.
018 *
019 * @see CurrentBatteryV2Response
020 */
021
022/**
023 * History log record Charging Stopped, opCode 35, size 26.
024 *
025 * <br>
026 *
027 * Battery snapshot written when charging stops, on both the Mobi and the t:slim X2, whether the
028 * pump was taken off the charger or charging finished at 100%. Every
029 * {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response} chargingStatus 1 to 0 transition seen in the maintainer's and a
030 * tester's Mobi captures (9 of 9) has one within seconds, and every record matches such a
031 * transition. On the t:slim X2 it usually follows a {@link UsbDisconnectedHistoryLog}.
032 *
033 * The class name is provisional: opcode 35 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
034 * app's history log list. {@link ChargingStartedHistoryLog} has the same layout. Fields not named
035 * here have not been identified and are exposed raw.
036 *
037 * @see CurrentBatteryV2Response
038 *
039 * 
040 * <table border='1'>
041 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
042 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>35</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
043 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Charging Stopped"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
044 * </table>
045 */@HistoryLogProps(
046    opCode = 35,
047    displayName = "Charging Stopped"
048)
049public class ChargingStoppedHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
050
051    private int currentBatteryAbc;
052    private int unknown12;
053    private int unknown14;
054    private int currentBatteryIbc;
055    private int unknown18;
056    private int lipoMv;
057    private int unknown22;
058    private int unknown24;
059
060    public ChargingStoppedHistoryLog() {}
061    public ChargingStoppedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int currentBatteryAbc, int unknown12, int unknown14, int currentBatteryIbc, int unknown18, int lipoMv, int unknown22, int unknown24) {
062        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
063        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, currentBatteryAbc, unknown12, unknown14, currentBatteryIbc, unknown18, lipoMv, unknown22, unknown24);
064        this.currentBatteryAbc = currentBatteryAbc;
065        this.unknown12 = unknown12;
066        this.unknown14 = unknown14;
067        this.currentBatteryIbc = currentBatteryIbc;
068        this.unknown18 = unknown18;
069        this.lipoMv = lipoMv;
070        this.unknown22 = unknown22;
071        this.unknown24 = unknown24;
072    }
073
074    public int typeId() {
075        return 35;
076    }
077
078    /**
079     * <table border="1">
080     * <caption>Parsed fields for ChargingStoppedHistoryLog:</caption>
081     * <tr><td><code>currentBatteryAbc</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
082     * <tr><td><code>unknown12</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
083     * <tr><td><code>unknown14</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
084     * <tr><td><code>currentBatteryIbc</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
085     * <tr><td><code>unknown18</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
086     * <tr><td><code>lipoMv</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 20)</code></td></tr>
087     * <tr><td><code>unknown22</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
088     * <tr><td><code>unknown24</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 24)</code></td></tr>
089     * </table>
090     */
091    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
092        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
093        this.cargo = raw;
094        parseBase(raw);
095        this.currentBatteryAbc = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
096        this.unknown12 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
097        this.unknown14 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
098        this.currentBatteryIbc = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
099        this.unknown18 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
100        this.lipoMv = Bytes.readShort(raw, 20);
101        this.unknown22 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
102        this.unknown24 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 24);
103    }
104
105    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int currentBatteryAbc, int unknown12, int unknown14, int currentBatteryIbc, int unknown18, int lipoMv, int unknown22, int unknown24) {
106        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
107            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(35, 0),
108            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
109            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
110            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentBatteryAbc),
111            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown12),
112            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown14),
113            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentBatteryIbc),
114            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown18),
115            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(lipoMv),
116            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown22),
117            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown24)));
118    }
119
120    /**
121     * @return {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getCurrentBatteryAbc()} at the time of the record
122     */
123    public int getCurrentBatteryAbc() {
124        return currentBatteryAbc;
125    }
126
127    /**
128     * Equal to {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getUnknown1()} at the time of the record;
129     * 100 * unknown18 / unknown12 is within 1 of {@link #getCurrentBatteryAbc()} in 246 of 249
130     * records.
131     *
132     * @return raw uint16 at offset 12
133     */
134    public int getUnknown12() {
135        return unknown12;
136    }
137
138    /**
139     * unknown14 / 10 - 273.15 is within 2.5 of {@link #getUnknown24()} in 197 of 202 Mobi
140     * records, so this is probably a temperature in 0.1 K (unconfirmed). Also present on the
141     * t:slim X2 (2947-3083 there).
142     *
143     * @return raw uint16 at offset 14
144     */
145    public int getUnknown14() {
146        return unknown14;
147    }
148
149    /**
150     * @return {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getCurrentBatteryIbc()} at the time of the record
151     */
152    public int getCurrentBatteryIbc() {
153        return currentBatteryIbc;
154    }
155
156    /**
157     * Equal to {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getUnknown2()} at the time of the record.
158     *
159     * @return raw uint16 at offset 18
160     */
161    public int getUnknown18() {
162        return unknown18;
163    }
164
165    /**
166     * Equal (within 2 mV) to {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getUnknown3()} at the time of the
167     * record.
168     *
169     * @return battery voltage in millivolts
170     */
171    public int getLipoMv() {
172        return lipoMv;
173    }
174
175    /**
176     * 0 on the t:slim X2 and on Mobi firmware 7.9.0.2. On an older-firmware Mobi it was 0, 1 or 2.
177     *
178     * @return raw uint16 at offset 22
179     */
180    public int getUnknown22() {
181        return unknown22;
182    }
183
184    /**
185     * 0 on the t:slim X2. On the Mobi it stays within a few units of
186     * {@link #getUnknown14()} / 10 - 273.15, which suggests a second temperature reading in
187     * degrees C (unconfirmed).
188     *
189     * @return raw uint16 at offset 24
190     */
191    public int getUnknown24() {
192        return unknown24;
193    }
194}
